items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Mula' only in response to the interviewer's statement about the name change to Miller. The interviewee does not claim personal interaction with Mula, but rather recounts a story involving Ormond Hug and Eddie.

ctx.x: Yeah, now, but it used to be Mula, Mala. I didn't know that. Some German guy told me that. He met him and it turned out his name was a German name. I think when he was in America it became Miller. Yeah, well he was hit from here.

Because I remember when he used to come to play his saxophone on a bandstand and he'd have a hole in his pants I'd say for a minute. Ormond hug. When Ormond, we got a hole in Ormond, Eddie said get Ormond, he said as a piano player, when Chris left, Sid Christensen. He says get Ormond hug. He says he's alright. He says okay, okay. So we went to a hole and Ormond came there with his uncle, Will Badinko. You know that name?
